node.title: DLI official terminal weight-4 relations excluded by normalized-section norm census
node.statement: All C(256,4)2^3=1,398,341,120 reduced signed weight-4 polynomials meet a 1,014,080-key normalized section that partitions into exactly 24,979 affine-Galois norm classes. Exact resultants have 88,086 factor records and 44,599 distinct prime factors; none below 2^256 has v_2(q-1)>=41, and the maximum is 29. Hence no official DLI production row contains a terminal weight-4 relation. Independent verifiers reconstruct the normalized orbit partition, certify every resultant by 17-prime CRT beyond 2*4^256, and check a shared 154,086-node recursive Pocklington graph. Weights 5 and 6 and WCL-ZONE remain open.
